name: Influence
overview: Scripture reveals the profound impact of influence through both positive and negative examples. The serpent's subtle deception of Eve in Genesis 3 demonstrates the destructive power of evil influence, leading to disobedience and sin. Conversely, leaders like Ezra and Nehemiah exemplify godly influence by turning the people to repentance and faithful service to God. Proverbs further encourages embracing wise instruction, highlighting that those who accept correction grow in understanding and walk in the way of life.
